title: DevOps Engineer
text:
DevOps Engineer - Example Cloud Services Pvt Ltd, Noida
2 to 5 years

Responsibilities
- Run our services on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS)
- Write Terraform for every environment
- Own CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and GitHub Actions
- Set up monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana
- Automate routine work with Bash scripts on Linux

Must have
- AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC)
- Docker, Kubernetes
- Terraform
- Jenkins or GitHub Actions
- Linux and shell scripting

Preferred
- Python
- Experience with HashiCorp Vault

Shift: general. Notice period: 30 days.
